name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a garage construction estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a garage construction estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group for a garage construction estimate, it is helpful to have a clear understanding of your goals for the space—whether it's for parking, storage, a workshop, or a converted living area. Consider your desired size, any specific features you envision (e.g., HVAC, plumbing), and a general idea of your budget. Having photos of your property and any inspiration images can also be beneficial. This preparation helps us conduct a more focused initial consultation, allowing us to provide an accurate estimate and begin tailoring a design solution that meets your unique needs.
